Talwanderweg Kaunertal

Kaunertal / Ötztal Alps
Difficulty ratings: easy
Duration: 2:30 h

"Auf der Ögg", i.e. up on the corner, are the listed farms, which are located on a viewing terrace high above Feichten. The path to the Moarhofer waterfall completes this beautiful circular hike.

Tour character

In the high-altitude, mountainous Kaunertal, the valley hikes also lead to panoramic heights. The hike from Feichten (1,287 m) up to the Ögghöfe farms (1,444 m) is an easy walk along the gravel farm access road. The rest of the way to Wasserfallblick leads along forest paths and trails. At just over five kilometers in length, this tranquil loop is a moderate hike that takes around two hours to complete.

Tour information

  • Requirement: easy
  • Duration: 2:30 h
  • Elevation uphill:295 hm
  • Elevation downhill:285 hm
